message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is an exhaustive breakdown of the UI design for the frontend developer assessment page:

### 1. UI Elements Overview
The document is a clean, text-heavy informational page with a single embedded **UI mockup** (screenshot of a web application) serving as a visual reference. The layout follows a standard document format with clear headings, body text, and a centered visual asset.

### 2. Layout Structure
*   **Container:** A single-column, centered content area with significant white space (padding/margins) on all sides.
*   **Sections:**
    *   **Header Section:** Contains the "Important" heading and its associated paragraph.
    *   **Divider:** A thin, horizontal rule (`<hr>`) separating the introductory text from the design reference.
    *   **Reference Section:** Contains the "Design References:" heading, sub-heading, and the large embedded mockup image.
    *   **Footer Text:** A concluding sentence at the bottom.
*   **Mockup Layout (Internal):** The embedded image shows a complex dashboard interface:
    *   **Top Bar:** Navigation icons and user profile.
    *   **Left Sidebar:** Input fields, a "Generate" button, and accordion-style dropdown menus ("Advance", "Styles").
    *   **Main Content Area:** A grid of thumbnail images at the top and a larger 2x4 grid of generated portrait images below.

### 3. Text Content (Verbatim)
*   **Heading 1:** `Important`
*   **Paragraph 1:** `You are welcome to use AI tools during this assessment. However, AI is only one tool. During the interview, we will discuss your submission in detail and ask you to explain your product decisions, engineering choices, and design rationale. We are evaluating your thinking—not whether AI helped you write code or generate ideas.`
*   **Heading 2:** `Design References:`
*   **Sub-heading:** `Mockup design:`
*   **Footer Text:** `While creating your own unique idea you can take reference from following links:`

### 4. Color Palette
*   **Background:** Pure white (`#FFFFFF`).
*   **Primary Text (Headings):** Dark Teal/Slate Blue (approx. `#1e3a4c` or `#0f3d4a`).
*   **Body Text:** Dark Grey/Black (approx. `#111` or `#222`).
*   **Divider Line:** Light Grey (approx. `#ddd` or `#ccc`).
*   **Mockup Background:** Very light grey/beige (approx. `#f9f9f7`).
*   **Accent Color (in Mockup):** Soft Coral/Orange (used for the "Generate" button and active tab indicator).

### 5. Typography Hierarchy
*   **Headings ("Important", "Design References:"):**
    *   **Font Family:** Sans-serif (likely Inter, Roboto, or System UI).
    *   **Weight:** Bold or Semi-Bold (600-700).
    *   **Size:** Large (approx. 24px - 28px).
    *   **Color:** Dark Teal.
*   **Sub-heading ("Mockup design:"):**
    *   **Weight:** Bold (700).
    *   **Size:** Medium-Large (approx. 18px - 20px).
    *   **Color:** Black/Dark Grey.
*   **Body Text:**
    *   **Weight:** Regular (400).
    *   **Size:** Standard (approx. 16px - 18px).
    *   **Line Height:** Generous (approx. 1.6) for readability.
    *   **Color:** Dark Grey.

### 6. Interactive Elements & Components
*   **Buttons (within Mockup):**
    *   **"Generate" Button:** Rounded rectangle (pill shape), solid coral/orange background, white text, includes a small sparkle/wand icon on the left.
*   **Inputs (within Mockup):**
    *   **Text Area:** Large rounded rectangle with placeholder text: "Describe your imagination to be converted to piece of art...".
    *   **Dropdowns:** "4 Images", "Model Name", "Advance", "Styles". These appear as white bars with chevron-down icons.
*   **Icons (within Mockup):**
    *   **Top Nav:** Home, Image, Video, Edit/Pencil, Music/Note, Gallery, Support/Headset, User Avatar.
    *   **Sidebar:** Sparkle icon (Generate button).

### 7. Image Placements
*   **Primary Visual:** One large, centered screenshot of an AI image generation tool (resembling Midjourney or Leonardo.ai).
    *   **Content of Screenshot:**
        *   **Top Row (Thumbnails):** ~12 small square images showing various styles (portraits, landscapes, abstract art).
        *   **Main Grid:** 8 larger portrait images of a woman with red/auburn hair in different poses and outfits (mostly cream-colored sweaters).
        *   **Sidebar Text:** Small blocks of descriptive text (prompts) next to the images.

### Summary for Recreation
To recreate this exactly, use a **max-width container (approx. 900px)** centered on a white background. Use a **dark teal sans-serif font** for headers. Insert a **1px light grey horizontal line** as a spacer. Embed the **mockup image** with slight border-radius and perhaps a subtle drop shadow to make it pop from the white background. Ensure ample vertical spacing (margin-bottom) between the sections.
